# T001 — Add one pre-retarget regression test

## Summary

One empty-receipt characterization `[Fact]` was added before retargeting. The project remains `net8.0`; the existing nine cases and the new case all pass.

## Changes

- `PriceCalculatorTests.cs`: `EmptyReceiptReportsZeroCountDiscountAndTotal` asserts `"0 item(s), discount 0.00, total 0.00"` for an empty list with `LOYAL5`. Diff contains exactly one new test and no edits to existing tests or production code.

## Decisions

- Preserve observed behavior rather than specify a new behavior: for an empty list, `SubtotalCents` returns zero, `Total` computes zero discount and total even with a recognized code, and `Receipt` sums zero quantities and formats zero amounts using invariant culture (`PriceCalculator.cs:33-69`). The approved plan selects this uncovered case; the passing pre-retarget TRX result confirms it.
- No framework or dependency changes in this task. Baseline source: `assessment.md` and `.modernization-scratch/baseline/ContainerUser_RUN-2491EE9B7FD_2026-10-28_23_00_24_net8.0.trx`.
